Production game UI artwork for one coherent 2D military comic game. Hand inked clean outlines, restrained angular cel shading, matte midnight navy and desaturated blue grey painted steel, fine warm grey edge wear, tiny muted turquoise indicator lights. Flat front view, orthographic, crisp shapes, understated professional game art, no photorealism, no 3D render, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark. Quiet readable surfaces, no busy patterns, no neon glow.
Panoramic illustrated military command room, massive blue grey steel beams frame the edges, muted cyan map screens and small warm amber lamps on the far right. Spacious shadowy center and left with very little detail for interface content. Wide establishing environment painting, cinematic atmosphere but readable flat comic shapes, no characters.
